decisions_added.decision: profileMap defaults to suggestProfileMapping (same id, else exact name -> map, else create) in BOTH preview and apply. Replace never maps (map in replace = E_BAD_MAPPING). Two backup profiles cannot map to one target.

Damaged or missing photo bytes = metadata-only record (thumb null) after explicit 'import-without'. JSON-only import never touches existing thumb/bytes. Photos whose check-in is missing are invalid (orphan-photo).
rebuildPrefs only after Merge, only for profiles that already had food logs and received new ones. Replace and restore-into-empty keep the backup's foodPrefs exactly.

lastImportSummary via setMeta, noteWrite() (one change) only when something was written, rebuildPrefs, post-import verification: all after the transaction; failures there become warnings, never undo the import. lastBackupAt never set by import.

Restaurant world seed foods derive kcal as round(4*protein + 4*carbs + 9*fat - 2*fiber), as A7.4 did for sweets, and never carry a brand. Indo-Chinese dishes use cuisine chinese plus spelling aliases because the cuisine enum has no Indo-Chinese value.

Alcoholic drinks are excluded from the seed while kcal is derived as round(4P+4C+9F-2*fiber): that formula has no alcohol energy term, so alcoholic values would be systematically low. Mocktails and non-alcoholic cafe drinks are in. Adding alcohol needs an explicit alcohol energy rule first.

Search rank scale (seed.js): tiers per term 0 exact, 1 leading whole words, 2 whole word anywhere, 3 string prefix, 4 word prefix. Names rank 0,2,3,4,5; aliases 1 (exact), 6,7,8,9. So an exact alias beats loose name matches (khichdi finds Khichuri) and a whole word beats a bare prefix (paan before Paneer), while stray alias phrases cannot beat real names. rank has no consumer outside seed.js.
